Verticals at every 1.000 panel point. The top chord is drawn running on about 1.00 past both end posts (matches the roof edges D and A' on S-02) but that length is not dimensioned here.
Panel chain (1.000 x 6, sub-totals 3.00 | 3.00, total 6.00) is recorded in the grid master (TRUSS T1 view); its panel points became y dummies per section 4 rule 4.
